path: Which organization are you setting up?
registrationHelp: This is your private declaration. Ayinou does not confirm a legal, nonprofit, or charity status from this form. Informal groups need no registration number.
protected: Government institutions require a separate review process.
existingHelp: A claim starts a review. Ownership changes only after independent approval. If you have an invitation, accept it in Institutions.
searchLabel: Search public organization names or handles
matchHelp: Check for an existing listing before creating one. A similar name may belong to a different organization.
draftSaved: Draft saved. Review the details before you submit.
incomplete: Add a name, handle, type, and country to finish this draft.
identity: Independently reviewed personal identity is required to finish setup.
authority: I confirm that I’m authorized to set up this organization or request ownership on its behalf.
duplicate: That handle is unavailable. Choose another handle or review a public match.
references: Provide two or three public HTTPS references on distinct sites that support your authority. Use public sources and leave out private documents.
created: Your unverified organization was created. You can manage it and apply for organization verification.

status.registered: Registered, as declared by the organization

claimResult.pending: Claim submitted. Independent review is pending and no ownership was granted.
claimResult.unavailable: The current claim status is unavailable.
